intent: Record which agent drafted each proposed element.

edit.summary:
I added a `drafted_by` field to proposed elements in `SKILL.md`, so the owner can see which agent drafted each one. I didn't run or test anything, and I left `EXAMPLES.md` unchanged.

- **Element object:** there is a new optional `drafted_by` property. It holds the name of the agent that drafted the element.
- **`propose_element`:** it now takes an optional `drafted_by` parameter and sets `target.drafted_by` from it. Only the owner can take `propose_element`, so the agent's name has to be passed in as a parameter. The actor id would only ever show the owner.

I made the field optional, not required. Elements that already exist have no drafter recorded, and `propose_element` calls that omit the name still work. The catch is that an element can still be proposed without a drafter. If you want every element to carry one, say so and I'll make it required.
